beforeTime.description: The range of time represented by the values used to calculate the before average.

beforeValues.description: The values used to calculate the before average.

beforeMean.description:
The aggregated value for the "before" query. By default this is the arithmetic mean (simple average), but may also
be another statistic as specified by {@link PerfMetricChangesSpec#aggregateBy}.

afterTime.description: The range of time represented by the values used to calculate the after average.

afterValues.description: The values used to calculate the after average.

afterMean.description:
The aggregated value for the "after" query. By default this is the arithmetic mean (simple average), but may also
be another statistic as specified by {@link PerfMetricChangesSpec#aggregateBy}.

change.description: The change fraction, after vs. before mean, positive or negative.

title:
This type represents a change in a particular metric/measure between two queries.

@see PerfMetric#changes
name: PerfMetricChange
